columns.name: SEQUENCE_NAME
columns.expr: weighted({'Signal: Hiring Sales Team': 8*(0.3+1.4*ramp(150)),'Competitor Renewal Play': 6,'Inbound Speed to Lead': 8,'Job Change Play': 5,'Enterprise Outbound Q4': 13,'RevOps Persona Cadence': 8,'Mid-Market Cold Call': 14,'Closed Lost Revival': 7,'SMB Nurture Calls': 12,'Webinar Follow-up': 7})

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.expr: weighted({"Brightline Health": 0.98, "Corvana Systems": 2.33, "Northpeak Logistics": 0.83, "Lumen Ledger": 2.11, "Halcyon Bio": 0.79, "Vantera Cloud": 1.55, "Ridgeway Insurance": 1.03, "Quillstone Media": 1.17, "Atlas Freightworks": 2.93, "Cobalt Payroll": 2.51, "Meridian Robotics": 1.26, "Fernwood Retail": 2.71, "Stratus Security": 1.03, "Kinetic Labs": 1.49, "Bluehaven Hotels": 2.64, "Orchard Fintech": 2.1, "Pinecrest Energy": 0.75, "Tidewater Analytics": 2.97, "Granite HR": 1.03, "Nimbus Telecom": 1.15, "Solace Wellness": 2.43, "Ironclad Data": 1.32, "Sparrow Commerce": 1.24, "Evergreen Credit": 0.68, "Helix Diagnostics": 0.73, "Summit Learning": 1.96, "Vector Mobility": 1.11, "Aurora Payments": 2.0, "Copperleaf Foods": 1.43, "Driftwood Travel": 1.63, "Beacon Legal": 2.9, "Polaris Manufacturing": 1.71, "Zephyr Software": 1.94, "Maple & Main Bank": 2.67, "Keystone Realty": 0.96, "Lattice AI": 0.89, "Riverstone Capital": 2.77, "Waypoint Fleet": 2.54, "Crescent Pharma": 1.12, "Tandem Staffing": 0.97})

columns.name: PROSPECT_SENIORITY
columns.expr: 'C-Level' if r['PROSPECT_PERSONA'] == 'Founder / CEO' else weighted({'VP': 22, 'Director': 34, 'Manager': 30, 'Individual Contributor': 14})

columns.name: PROSPECT_TITLE
columns.expr: pick(['CEO','Co-Founder','Founder & CEO']) if r['PROSPECT_SENIORITY'] == 'C-Level' else ({'VP':'VP of ','Director':'Director of ','Manager':'Manager, ','Individual Contributor':'Specialist, '}[r['PROSPECT_SENIORITY']] + r['PROSPECT_DEPARTMENT'])

columns.name: BUYING_SIGNAL
columns.expr: weighted({"No Signal": 60, "Hiring Sales Team": 7, "Recent Funding": 5, "Competitor Renewal": 5, "Leadership Hire": 4, "Webinar Attendee": 4, "Asset Downloaded": 4, "Prior Champion": 3, "Timing Objection": 2, "Announced Expansion": 3, "20% Headcount Jump": 3}) if r['SEQUENCE_SOURCE'] == 'Nooks' or chance(0.25) else 'No Signal'

columns.name: DIAL_MODE
columns.expr: 'Signal-Based Dialing' if (r['BUYING_SIGNAL'] != 'No Signal' and chance(0.15 + 0.7 * ramp(150))) else ('Parallel Dialer' if chance(0.72) else 'Single Dial')

columns.name: P_CONNECT
columns.expr: min(0.6, {"Sales Leader": 0.125, "RevOps Leader": 0.08, "Marketing Leader": 0.105, "IT & Security": 0.07, "Finance Leader": 0.09, "HR & People": 0.135, "Founder / CEO": 0.065}[r['PROSPECT_PERSONA']] * (1 + 1.5 * ramp(150) if r['PROSPECT_PERSONA'] == 'RevOps Leader' else 1) * (1.35 if r['DIAL_MODE'] == 'Signal-Based Dialing' else 1.0) * (1.15 if r['PROSPECT_SENIORITY'] in ('Manager','Individual Contributor') else 0.9 if r['PROSPECT_SENIORITY'] in ('VP','C-Level') else 1) * (1.1 if 10 <= r['CALL_HOUR'] <= 11 or 15 <= r['CALL_HOUR'] <= 16 else 0.95))

columns.name: CONVERSATION_FLAG
columns.expr: 1 if r['CONNECTED_FLAG'] and chance(0.58 + (0.06 if r['REP_TENURE'] in ('1-2 years','2+ years') else 0)) else 0

columns.name: OBJECTION_TYPE
columns.expr: weighted({'Not Interested': 28,'Send Me an Email': 22,'Bad Timing': 17,'Using a Competitor': 14*(1+0.6*ramp(240)),'No Budget': 11,'Not the Right Person': 8}) if r['CONVERSATION_FLAG'] and chance(0.72) else 'None'

columns.name: OBJECTION_HANDLED_FLAG
columns.expr: (1 if chance((0.17 - 0.1 * ramp(240)) if (r['REP_NAME'] == 'Lucas Wright' and r['OBJECTION_TYPE'] == 'Using a Competitor') else min(0.95, {"Not Interested": 0.42, "Send Me an Email": 0.62, "Bad Timing": 0.66, "Using a Competitor": 0.5, "No Budget": 0.45, "Not the Right Person": 0.72}[r['OBJECTION_TYPE']] * (1.15 if r['REP_TENURE'] in ('1-2 years','2+ years') else 0.9 if r['REP_TENURE'] == '0-3 months' else 1))) else 0) if r['OBJECTION_TYPE'] != 'None' else None

columns.name: MEETING_BOOKED_FLAG
columns.expr: 1 if r['CONVERSATION_FLAG'] and chance(0.30 if r['OBJECTION_TYPE'] == 'None' else 0.24 if r['OBJECTION_HANDLED_FLAG'] else 0.03) else 0

columns.name: CALLBACK_REQUESTED_FLAG
columns.expr: 1 if (r['CONNECTED_FLAG'] and not r['MEETING_BOOKED_FLAG'] and chance(0.75 if r['OBJECTION_TYPE'] in ('Bad Timing','Send Me an Email') else 0.2)) else 0

columns.name: CALL_OUTCOME
columns.expr: 'Meeting Booked' if r['MEETING_BOOKED_FLAG'] else 'Conversation' if r['CONVERSATION_FLAG'] else 'Connected' if r['CONNECTED_FLAG'] else weighted({'No Answer': 55, 'Voicemail': 38, 'Bad Number': 7})

columns.name: TALK_TIME_SEC
columns.expr: int(lognorm(430, 0.35)) if r['MEETING_BOOKED_FLAG'] else int(lognorm(190, 0.5)) if r['CONVERSATION_FLAG'] else int(lognorm(35, 0.4)) if r['CONNECTED_FLAG'] else int(lognorm(24, 0.3)) if r['CALL_OUTCOME'] == 'Voicemail' else 0

columns.name: CALL_SCORE
columns.expr: int(min(100, max(20, (55 + (18 if r['MEETING_BOOKED_FLAG'] else 0) + (10 if r['OBJECTION_HANDLED_FLAG'] else -8 if r['OBJECTION_HANDLED_FLAG'] == 0 else 0) + uniform(-12, 14))))) if r['CONVERSATION_FLAG'] else None

post.name: DAYS_OVERDUE
post.expr: (age - r['CALLBACK_IN_DAYS']) if r['CALLBACK_STATUS'] in ('Overdue','Due Today') else None
